notes: www.unimi.it refuses us (robots.txt 403), so programmes come from the university's official international application portal apply.unimi.it (DreamApply). English requirements are stated as CEFR levels only (no IELTS/TOEFL scores), and deadlines load only after choosing an applicant category, so none were recorded. Capped at 20 master's programmes; the institution listing on apply.unimi.it may not show every course.

programs.name: Master's Degree in Data Science for Economics and Health

academic.text: Any bachelor's degree with at least 30 ECTS in computer science/mathematics, economics/statistics and medical statistics
academic.quote: No matter the first-cycle degree (i.e. a Bachelor’s degree) they hold, all applicants must have earned at least 30 credits (ECTS) in certain basic study fields covered by the degree programme, namely computer science and mathematics, economics and statistics, medical statistics.

prerequisites.text: English at CEFR B2 or higher
prerequisites.quote: A B2 or higher level of proficiency in English is required for admission.

prerequisites.text: Online admission test of background knowledge
prerequisites.quote: All applicants must take an online admission test assessing their background knowledge.
